## History

Ludovic Speed lived in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), where he was involved in a long-running, elderly love affair. His romantic situation became a topic of discussion for [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in a letter she wrote to Philippa from her new home at 'Wayside'.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Philippa P5](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0005), [v3 ch.Philippa P8](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0008), [v3 ch.Philippa P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009)_

## Relationships

### [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ludovic-speed--theodora-dix.md)

Ludovic Speed began courting [Theodora Dix](../character/theodora-dix.md) in Volume 3. Their ongoing elderly romance in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) is noted by local residents, including [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in a letter to her friend Philippa.
